Correctness/security defects were scarce, so two of three findings are i18n-coverage gaps on distinct unmined features.

signals.source: rotating-expert-review (dispatcher Tier-1d 2026-09-05 ppt-web-ui portfolio dead interaction)
evidence: PortfolioDashboardPage.tsx:266-268 -- every PropertyCard rendered in the portfolio dashboard grid is given an onClick handler whose entire body is a comment: `onClick={() => { // TODO: navigate to property detail route }}`. The cards render as interactive (PropertyCard receives and wires onClick) so a manager clicking a property tile on a SHIPPED dashboard gets zero response -- a dead-end user-facing interaction, not merely a missing feature flag.

The map at PortfolioDashboardPage.tsx:264-273 wires this no-op onClick onto EVERY property card (`propertyCards.map((property) => <PropertyCard ... onClick={() => { /* TODO */ }} />)`), so the defect affects the whole grid, not a single card. The surrounding query states (isLoading/isError/empty at lines 256-261) are handled, which makes the silent click failure more surprising -- the data loads fine, the tile looks clickable, nothing happens.

Reproduce: grep -n 'TODO: navigate to property detail' frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/portfolio-performance/pages/PortfolioDashboardPage.tsx . Non-duplicate: no prior ppt-web-ui signal references portfolio-performance/PortfolioDashboardPage (the only prior portfolio findings, code-review-ppt-web-ui-portfolio-* , concern PortfolioListPage / PortfolioDashboardPage i18n and were not emitted; verified against all *ppt-web-ui*.json).

Landable remedy (frontend-only, no backend/KMP): wire the onClick to the property-detail route via react-router useNavigate (the sibling detail route/component exists in this feature), or -- if the detail route is genuinely not built yet -- remove the onClick and the interactive affordance so the tile does not present as clickable. Medium severity: broken user-facing interaction on a shipped manager dashboard. Confidence medium: the no-op body is code-verified statically; whether the detail route exists to navigate to was not run-confirmed.

The entire marketplace page set renders hardcoded English with ZERO useTranslation wiring (grep -c useTranslation returns 0 for all five pages), on a manager-facing product that ships react-i18next (root CLAUDE.md; the rest of ppt-web localizes via useTranslation as seen in voting/VoteDetailPage). Any non-English manager sees these screens entirely in English.

Concrete hardcoded literals: MarketplacePage.tsx:55 '

Service Provider Marketplace

', :133 'No providers found', :168 'Load More Providers'; ProviderDetailPage.tsx:94 'Back to Marketplace', :222 'Contact Information', :262 'Coverage Area'; ProviderProfilePage.tsx:184 'Provider Dashboard', :251 'Average Rating', :255 'Total Reviews'; CreateRfqPage.tsx:69 'Create Request for Quote', :80 'Select Providers', :87 'Create RFQ'; RfqListPage.tsx:66 'Requests for Quote', :203 'Total RFQs'.

Reproduce: for f in MarketplacePage ProviderDetailPage ProviderProfilePage CreateRfqPage RfqListPage; do echo $f $(grep -c useTranslation frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/marketplace/pages/$f.tsx); done (all print 0).

Non-duplicate: the only prior marketplace signal (code-review-ppt-web-ui-contact-labels-in-api-client, 2026-09-04) concerns emergency-contact label TYPES in the api-client package, and prior i18n findings target the workflow-automation / emergency / community / buildings features -- none touch marketplace page components. Verified against all *ppt-web-ui*.json.

Landable remedy (frontend-only): wrap the marketplace page literals in t('marketplace.*') keys and add the entries to messages/en.json (+ the other locale bundles). Low severity (i18n gap), high tractability -- a mechanical, feature-scoped pass. Confidence medium: literals and the absence of useTranslation are code-verified statically; not runtime-confirmed.

The portfolio-performance feature pages/components render hardcoded English with no useTranslation, including user-facing loading/error/empty states -- PortfolioDashboardPage.tsx:257 'Loading properties…', :259 'Failed to load property performance.', :261 'No properties in this portfolio yet.'; PortfolioListPage.tsx:115 'Total Value', :121 'Total Equity', :125 'Total Properties'; PortfolioCard.tsx:64 'Total Value', :68 'Total Equity'; CashFlowChart.tsx:71 'Total Income', :77 'Total Expenses', :83 'Total NOI'. Error/empty-state copy in particular is exactly the text a non-English manager most needs localized.

This is a DISTINCT feature and a distinct landable task from the marketplace i18n finding above (separate directory, separate key namespace, separate PR); it is grouped separately so each can be claimed independently.
Reproduce: grep -rL useTranslation frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/portfolio-performance --include='*.tsx' | grep -v .test. lists these files as having no i18n wiring.
Non-duplicate: no prior *ppt-web-ui*.json signal references portfolio-performance. Verified across the full signal history.

Landable remedy (frontend-only): introduce t('portfolio.*') keys for the page/component literals (prioritize the loading/error/empty-state strings) and register them in the locale bundles. Low severity, mechanical. Confidence medium: static-only (literals + missing useTranslation code-verified, not runtime-confirmed).
